description: IEA (International Energy Agency) energy statistics for one country and one indicator (default CO2BySource: CO2 emissions by fuel and product, MtCO2), from the public IEA stats API. Returns the latest year(s) in the source. Indicator list is the IEA catalogue; not every indicator has data for every country. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: IEA country code (3 letters), e.g. USA

years.description: How many latest years to return, 1 to 5 (default 1)

name: energy_iea_energy_statistics_api
title: Energy Iea Energy Statistics Api
